entities.name: Silvanus of the Seventy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Silvanus is a traditional figure in Eastern Orthodox tradition assumed to be one of the Seventy Apostles, those followers of Jesus sent out by him in Luke 10. Peter makes mention of him in his first epistle.
